description: This file defines the UserService interface, specifying methods for user management operations such as saving, listing, retrieving, deleting users, and changing passwords.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of all User objects.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a User by its ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a User by its ID.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Changes the password for a given User.
